$comment: Tenulo's bundled food list. Edit this file, then run: python scripts/foods/build_foods.py
Each food is either one USDA SR Legacy food ('usda': fdc_id or ingredient key) or a recipe
('recipe': [[ingredient, raw grams], ...] with 'yield': grams of the finished dish, water included
in both). '@food-id' in a recipe uses another food of this list. Portions are [unit, grams], the
default first; '100 g' and '1 g' are added to every food by the generator. Liquids: 1 ml = 1 g.
'note' explains every recipe and every stand-in SR food. No brand names, ever.

fiberAssumedZero.$comment: SR foods that have no fibre value because fibre was not analysed; all are animal foods or plain water, which have none.
